The part is $7,$ the percentage is $14%,$ and we need to find the whole.

To do this, we can use the following formula:

$$
\text{whole}=\text{part}÷\text{percentage}
$$

 

Before we can substitute our numbers into the formula, we need to express $14%$ as a fraction:

$$
\frac{14}{100}=\frac{14÷2}{100÷2}=\frac{7}{50}
$$

We can now substitute our numbers into the formula, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{whole} & =7÷14% \\  & =7÷\frac{7}{50} \\  & =7\times \frac{50}{7} \\  & =\frac{7}{7}\times 50 \\  & =1\times 50 \\  & =50\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $14%$ of $50$ is $7.$
